title: Resolution Gate Preconditions, Valid/Invalid Paths & Concurrency Evidence

verifiedPaths.invalidPath: 0 completed actions + empty note => rejected by Resolution Gate
verifiedPaths.validPath1: Staff resolution note provided => transitions to RESOLVED
verifiedPaths.validPath2: >= 1 completed ActionTaken present => note optional => transitions to RESOLVED
verifiedPaths.concurrencyProtection: Stale update detects collision => returns 409 Conflict with safe refresh
verifiedPaths.terminalStateProtection: CANCELLED tickets locked against transitions and actions
